scope: M3-07 local online backup and isolated restore; manual retention operations only

live_drill.scope: online backup of running research memory; isolated restore only

privacy.actual_artifacts: ignored var directory; directory 0700 and files 0600

limits: No live database replacement, schema migration, image update or Hub push
Backup validity defaults to 7 days; physical cleanup remains manual
Pre-deletion backups may contain later-deleted messages; no cross-backup deletion journal
No scheduler, encryption, off-site replication or failover automation
Only conversation database; source corpora and PubMed ledger require separate recovery
SHA256 detects corruption, not malicious replacement by a trusted local operator
